title: Is the guidance on Sharing Files and Folders still current?

question.author: member_065
question.body: I found an older discussion about sharing files and folders. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Pick a permission level — View (read-only), Edit (add and modify files), or Comment (read and leave comments) — then copy the generated link. By default the link works for anyone who has it; switch to "Specific people" to restrict access to named individuals or groups. To share a file or folder, right-click it in any CloudBox client and choose Share, or use the Share button in the web app. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
